set: Bottled water prices, per US gallon
note: What a gallon of each bottled water actually costs, so the profiles above can be compared on money as well as chemistry. EVERY price carries the date it was observed, the seller, the exact pack it came from and a link, because a bottled-water price is worth nothing without them: it moves with the retailer, the region, the pack size and the week. Treat these as dated observations, not as the price. pricePerGallonUsd is always priceUsd divided by volumeGallons, recomputed by validate-prices.mjs rather than trusted.
sellerNote: Two kinds of seller appear. WebstaurantStore is a national foodservice distributor selling by the case, which is the closest thing to a stable, checkable published US price and is roughly what a brewer buying in volume would pay. Producer-direct prices come from the brand's own shop and run well above supermarket shelf prices - treat those as an upper bound, not a typical cost.
coverage: Only four of the bottled waters have a verified price. Live retail prices could not be retrieved for the rest: Walmart serves unrelated products for retired item IDs, Target returns 404, and Costco, Amazon, Kroger and Walgreens all refuse automated requests. Rather than fill the gap from memory - which would produce undated, unverifiable numbers of exactly the kind this file exists to avoid - the remaining waters carry no price at all. Adding one is a six-field edit.

estimateNote: ESTIMATES, NOT OBSERVATIONS. These are best guesses at a typical US supermarket price per gallon, made on the date shown, deliberately rounded UP so a batch is over-budgeted rather than under. They are not sourced, not checkable and not a substitute for looking at a shelf: US bottled water pricing varies by region, chain and week far more than these single figures suggest, and imports with thin distribution vary most of all. They are kept in a separate list from `prices` so the two can never be mistaken for one another - anything in `prices` was actually seen at a named seller on a named date with a link, and nothing here was.
